verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is fundamentally a local inference engine with no external dependencies, runnable via CLI/server on CPU or GPU entirely on-device (llama-cpp-gh-1,2,5,6,7,9,16), and community reports confirm real hands-on local usage on personal machines (Mac, desktop CPU) without any cloud calls (llama-cpp-comm-4,5,6,12,14). missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement about offline/air-gapped operation or privacy guarantee, though it's strongly implied by the architecture.
